BrochureContent.Content:
A unique opportunity to purchase this iconic landmark building in the heart of Roscrea town. This is one of the most iconic buildings in Roscrea town situated on Castle Street opposite Damer House and St. Johns Castle. The subject property is in the heart of the main trading area in Roscrea town adjoining Roscrea Shopping Centre and close to AIB and Bank of Ireland capturing most of the towns footfall. 
The property dates back to c.1870 and is of apparent architectural quality with carved elements, such as the door cases and rope mouldings, enliven the solid stone construction. The masonry and detailing are clearly the work of skilled craftsmen. Ashlar sandstone walls with channelled rusticated sandstone, timber sliding sash windows and stone sills. Round-headed doorways with stone surrounds with rope moulding and decorative keystones, fanlights with timber battened doors and stone steps. Sandstone segmental-headed carriage arch. 
The ground floor comprises of the successfully trading Lilly O`Brien`s Bar and Lounge and is currently under a leased agreement until February 2028. The upper floors comprise of newly refurbished apartments with 2 x one bed apartments on the first floor and a three bed apartment on the second floor. There are also two large storage rooms, one on the first floor and one on the second floor ready for conversion to a bedsit or office use. 
Mains Services, Electric and Pellet stove heating. 

Viewing of this impressive property is highly recommended.
